description:
## Goal

Represent operations implemented by the compiler/runtime as typed intrinsics rather than fictitious extern functions. One resolved intrinsic identity owns its exact input and result lanes, guard admissibility, fault behavior and lowering contract. Display names and linker symbols are never post-resolution semantic authority.

This ticket absorbs every valid requirement of fz-5xp.29 because the operator/comparison shims and the process-taking pseudo-externs are one indivisible model change. Leaving either family in extern syntax would preserve the compatibility path this cutover exists to delete.

## Correct model

Add one closed Intrinsic identity at the existing source/lowering boundary. Runtime-library declarations resolve it once and LoweredBody retains it with the validated semantic signature. Ordinary interpreter execution, native lowering and guard execution consume that same typed identity. Backend implementations may differ mechanically, but they exhaustively implement one descriptor and one Value-or-Fault contract.

The identity must distinguish exact operand/result lanes, integer div from integer-input float-result slash, widening equality from structural identity, mixed noncommutative lanes, and process/runtime effects. Only explicitly guard-admissible intrinsic identities may terminate a reified guard helper. An arbitrary extern or same-spelled user function is never admitted by spelling or ABI resemblance.

Migrate in this cut every current intrinsic wearing extern syntax: the arithmetic/comparison operator shims from fz-5xp.29 and fz_panic, fz_self, fz_send, fz_spawn, fz_spawn_opt, fz_make_ref and fz_make_resource. Generic extern handling must reject intrinsic declarations and never intercept them by name.

## Strategy and deletion

Reuse FunctionId, FunctionDefined and LoweredBody; do not add a purity registry, symbol side table, scheduler fact or second signature resolver. Replace the source declaration fiction with the typed intrinsic form, then delete ARITH_SHIMS, typed comparison symbol parsers, interpreter symbol interception, native name if-chains and obsolete runtime-symbol claims for migrated entries. Retain real extern ownership and ABI checking for actual callable symbols.

Do not inline Kernel wrappers here; fz-5xp.20 owns that later optimization. Do not fold dispatch Region emitters; fz-5xp.22 retains its bitstring field-walk scope.

## TDD and acceptance

Red-first tests prove every declared intrinsic is claimed exhaustively on interpreter, JIT and AOT; no intrinsic can reach dlsym or generic extern marshalling; custom same-spelled functions remain ordinary functions; exact lane/domain behavior, widening equality, structural identity, integer slash, faults and process effects agree across doors. Prove unchanged artifacts and no extra work for unchanged/unrelated requests.

Update extern/runtime documentation. Run focused tests, all three doors, full library and fixture gates, formatting, check and strict Clippy. Remove probes and transition scaffolding. Fresh ticket-scoped cold adversarial review precedes one commit and close.
title: Give runtime intrinsics one typed declaration and semantic authority
